description: T21 Mythic pack art (GDD §7, §19): one style-matched call using the two approved realm packs as style images, so the Mythic satchel sits on the same shelf.

jobs.styleDescription: Cozy whimsical storybook pixel art of a single sealed card pack as a 64x64 game sprite. Chunky, readable silhouette with round friendly shapes. Clean 1 px dark plum outline, soft 2-3 step shading lit from the top-left, small bright highlights, clean pixel clusters without dithering noise or blur. Muted, earthy palette. Transparent background, no ground, no shadow, no text.
jobs.description: a sealed card pack shaped like a plump little cloth satchel of deep midnight velvet with teal and seafoam starmetal trim, crimped and stitched top seam, a band of small glowing carved runes running around the middle, a chunky golden padlock with a keyhole hanging on the front clasp, slightly bulging with cards inside, upright, centered, front view, precious and magical but cozy, transparent background, 1 px dark outline, soft shading, light from top-left, no text, no frame, no scenery
